cells.gaps: No share of local offices registering digitally is published: 242 health facilities are counted as equipped (ZAF-010, March 2026) against no total, the health department counts 299 of 1,445 maternity facilities (ZAF-040, March 2025) and an older count gives 391, and how the 325 front offices make the record is stated only in general terms (ZAF-021). Deaths have no digital registration on record; the twelve-month advance (ZAF-046) carries no figure, while e-Birth missed its 2025/26 targets (ZAF-047, ZAF-051); no dated source says in terms that rural offices are outside the system, so rural gap is not set. ZAF-001 and ZAF-002 are dated after the as-at and ZAF-006 to ZAF-008 are from an excluded source; none was used.
cells.note: Births are registered online at health facilities by Home Affairs officials and captured onto the National Population Register at local offices, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or a count with a denominator; the newest count is of facilities equipped with no total, and the one count with a denominator is 299 of 1,445, a minority.
